payload.script_block: $errs = @(); Get-WindowsCapability -Online -Name 'Language.OCR*' | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Installed' -and $_.Name -notmatch 'ru-RU|en-US|ja-JP|zh-CN|ko-KR' } | ForEach-Object { $cap = $_.Name; try { Remove-WindowsCapability -Online -Name $cap -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null } catch { $errs += "$cap: $($_.Exception.Message)" } }; if ($errs.Count -gt 0) { throw "Failed capabilities: $($errs -join '; ')" }
